title: fix(driver-mongodb): two records with a null unique field are both admitted, as on driver-sql and driver-memory
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9JDHkRvsqpBwWHeNYZk2JHR)_
Fixes #29278

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：MongoDB 驱动的唯一索引不再把 `null` 当成一个值：两条唯一字段为空（`null` 或缺失）的记录都能保存，和 SQL、内存驱动一致；真正的重复值（含 `''`）照旧报 `E11000`。
- **为什么改**：旧索引是 `sparse`，只跳过“没有这个字段”的文档，显式 `null` 仍进索引，所以第二条清空唯一字段的记录被拒。已用真实 mongod 8.3.7 在主干上复现。
- **风险与回滚**：已部署的集合在下次 schema 同步时会把旧的 sparse 唯一索引删掉并按新形态重建（新索引约束更少，必然建成功）；中间有毫秒级无唯一约束窗口，若期间写入重复值则同步失败并报错，不会静默。每个唯一索引多一个普通读索引，写入成本略增。回滚 = revert 本 PR（按源码推断、未实测：旧代码遇到同名的新形索引会在同步时报 86，需先手工删掉该索引）。
- **先看**：`packages/drivers/driver-mongodb/src/mongodb-schema.ts` 的 `nullDistinctUniqueOps` 与 `rebuildLegacySparseUnique`；`src/mongodb-unique-null-distinct.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-mongodb exec vitest run src/mongodb-unique-null-distinct.test.ts`，默认 7 个 DDL 测试绿、8 个真实 mongod 测试跳过；加 `OS_TEST_MONGODB_MEMORY_SERVER_ENABLED=1` 且能拿到 mongod 时 15 个全绿（主干上 8 红）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The unique index is NULL-distinct.** `syncCollectionSchema` built a field-level `unique` and a declared `indexes[]` entry carrying `unique` as `{ unique: true, sparse: true }`. Both are now `{ unique: true, partialFilterExpression: { FIELD: { $type: [every non-null BSON type] } } }`, one entry per key part, with no `sparse` (MongoDB refuses `sparse` beside a partial filter). A document with a `null` or missing value in any key part is not constrained; every other value is constrained exactly as before.
  - Why a type list: MongoDB refuses `$ne` / `$not` inside a partial filter (`{ $exists: true, $ne: null }` → `CannotCreateIndex`, code 67, measured).
  - Why the full list and not the field's declared type: a stored value of an unexpected type stays constrained, as under the sparse index.
- **A plain read index beside each unique index.** The planner cannot use a partial index for an equality lookup (measured: `find({ code: 'X' })` → `COLLSCAN` on the partial index, `EXPRESS_IXSCAN` on the old sparse one; a single `$type: 'string'` filter is not used either). So each unique index also gets `idx_FIELDS`, a plain index over the same keys (the name a declared plain index over those columns already gets, so they converge). A plain index already present under another name (a lookup's `idx_FIELD_lookup`) answers `IndexOptionsConflict` (85), which the loop already skips. An author-named unique index that already takes the `idx_FIELDS` name gets no read index.
- **Declared `indexes[]` unique entries are in this fix, not left on the old shape.** A single-column declaration and a field-level `unique` converge on one index name (`idx_FIELD_unique`, pinned in `mongodb-schema-declared-indexes.test.ts`); leaving the declared route sparse would ask for one name with two option sets. Multi-column: a `null` in ANY key part exempts the row, the rule `memory-unique-constraint.ts` states for driver-sql and driver-memory.
- **Existing sparse indexes on deployed collections are rebuilt at the next schema sync (measured).** Asking for the new options under the old name is answered `IndexKeySpecsConflict` (86) on 8.3.7, and `collMod` cannot change `sparse` / `partialFilterExpression`. On that conflict the loop reads the collection's indexes; when the same-name index is exactly the legacy shape this driver built (`unique: true`, `sparse: true`, same keys in the same order, no partial filter) it is dropped and created again under its own name. Measured on a real server: a collection seeded with the legacy index, a `null` row and an `'X'` row refuses a second `null` (`E11000`) before the sync; after `syncSchema` the index carries the partial filter and no `sparse`, a second `null` is admitted, a second `'X'` is still refused, and a second sync is a no-op.
  - The rebuild always succeeds on existing data: the new index constrains a subset of what the old one did.
  - Between the drop and the create there is a moment with no unique index; a non-null duplicate written in that moment makes the create fail `E11000`, which is thrown (the sync fails loudly, the field is not left unconstrained). The read index is created first, so lookups stay indexed. A concurrent sync's drop of an already-dropped index (`IndexNotFound`, 27) is ignored.
  - Any other same-name index (an option this driver never wrote, or other keys) is left alone and answers as before: 85 skipped, 86 thrown.
- **What the driver writes is unchanged.** Not changed: driver-sql, driver-memory, `packages/spec`, any error code. A non-null duplicate is refused with the server's own `E11000 duplicate key error` (code 11000), as before.

## Tests

No existing test was edited. One new file, `packages/drivers/driver-mongodb/src/mongodb-unique-null-distinct.test.ts`, two suites:

- **Recording fake `Db` (7 tests, runs on every lane):** the field-level index options (partial filter, no `sparse`); the read index created before the unique one; the declared two-column filter over both parts; the author-named collision; the legacy rebuild sequence `createIndex → dropIndex → createIndex`; and two controls where a same-name index the driver did not build (extra `collation`; other keys) is not dropped and the `86` still throws.
- **Real mongod (8 tests, opt-in `OS_TEST_MONGODB_MEMORY_SERVER_ENABLED=1`, #5517):** two `null` creates admitted; two updates clearing to `null` admitted; two missing admitted; a non-null duplicate refused `11000` with message starting `E11000 duplicate key error`; two `''` refused; declared `(region, tag)`: `(eu, null)` twice admitted, `(eu, t)` twice refused; a lookup by the unique field is not a `COLLSCAN`; the legacy-index migration.

<details><summary>Red on main, green on head (real mongod 8.3.7)</summary>

`mongodb-schema.ts` restored to `276ca307` in the tree only, the new file run, then restored to HEAD (`git diff HEAD` empty, status clean). The suites import `src/` directly (no `dist/` in the path).

| Reading | Result |
|---|---|
| Base `276ca307` | `Tests 8 failed, 7 passed (15)`. `admits two records whose unique field is null`: `expected 11000 to be 'ok'`; the migration test: `expected true to be undefined` (`sparse` still set). The 7 that pass on base are the ones that must: missing ×2 admitted, non-null and `''` duplicates refused, the lookup index, the author-named case, the two leave-alone controls. |
| Head `84fb196d` | `Tests 15 passed (15)`, no suite skipped |

Premise probe on base, raw client against the same server (`{ f: 1 }` index): sparse unique: two `null` → second `E11000`; two missing → both `ok`; two `''`, two `'x'`, `1` and `1.0`, two equal dates, two `true` → second `E11000`. The partial index answers the same row for every case except two `null` (both `ok`).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations of the negative pins</summary>

Each mutation was made with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob changed, then restored with blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty). No build leg: the suite reads `src/`.

| Ablation | Red |
|---|---|
| A1: the unique index built `unique: false` | 6 failed / 15, incl. `still refuses a non-null duplicate`: `expected undefined to be 11000`, `''` refused, `(eu, t)` refused, the migration's `'X'` refusal |
| A2: any same-name index read as the legacy shape | 2 failed / 15: both leave-alone controls |
| A3: no read index | 3 failed / 15, incl. `serves a lookup … not a collection scan`: `expected '{"isCached":false,"stage":"COLLSCAN",…' not to contain 'COLLSCAN'` |

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The same case on all three drivers, measured** (head `84fb196d`, built `dist`, each driver's own `syncSchema` + `create`, field `code` `unique: 'global'`, declared `(region, tag)` unique):

  | case | memory | sql (SQLite) | mongo |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `code` null ×2 | ok, ok | ok, ok | ok, ok |
  | `code` missing ×2 | ok, ok | ok, ok | ok, ok |
  | `code` `''` ×2 | ok, refused | ok, refused | ok, refused |
  | `code` `'X'` ×2 | ok, refused | ok, refused | ok, refused |
  | `(eu, null)` ×2 | ok, ok | ok, ok | ok, ok |
  | `(eu, t)` ×2 | ok, refused | ok, refused | ok, refused |

  On base, mongo answered `ok, refused` for both `null` rows.
- **No shared conformance case-set was added.** The case-sets live in `packages/spec/src/data/*-conformance.ts`, which this lane does not edit. The table above is the cross-driver reading; a shared `unique` case-set is an open question for the spec seat. `check:driver-conformance`: 66 covered, 0 DEBT, 0 exempt, on base and head (unchanged, as expected with no new case-set).
- **The real-server suite runs on no CI lane** (opt-in since #5517). The 7 DDL tests are the ones CI runs. This PR's real-server readings were taken with a MongoDB 8.3.7 `mongod` from conda-forge (`mongodb-8.3.7-hc064ac0_0.conda`, sha256 matching conda-forge's index) supplied to `mongodb-memory-server` through `MONGOMS_SYSTEM_BINARY`, because `fastdl.mongodb.org` is refused in the card container.
- **Write cost.** Each unique index now has a plain read index beside it, so a write to a unique field updates two indexes instead of one.
- **`''` still collides**, as on driver-sql and driver-memory: `''` is a value. PR #29271 (open) makes the engine store a cleared optional unique text field as `null`; with this PR, Mongo admits those too.
